mechanism: Keep ordinary Adam gradients and moments. Postcondition particle displacements with row cap lr*sqrt(latent_dim)/q, where q is beta2 EMA of fraction of rows sampled in the actual G backward; initialize EMA from first batch. All other updates unchanged.
rationale: Prior fixed cap passes ring but eliminates rare mass; account for missing visits to preserve expected per-global-step travel in sparse tables. Shared_coordinate recovered rare shape but ring collapsed to six.
optimizer_updates: One D plus one G/particle update per frozen iteration; particle custom update substitutes original Adam table update.
extra_work: One particle clone, index bincount, exposure EMA, and row norm/broadcast after ordinary Adam. No extra network work; equal-step, not exact equal-compute.
